title: Spotify
status.missing.title: spoti is not installed
status.missing.detail: This widget talks to Spotify through the spoti CLI. Install it and the panel picks it up on its own.
status.notConfigured.title: Not connected to Spotify
status.notConfigured.detail: Connect your Spotify account once in the terminal that opens. You need a free Spotify developer app; the script walks you through it.
status.unreachable.title: Spotify not reachable
status.unreachable.detail: Check your internet connection. The panel retries on its own.
status.error.title: spoti ran into a problem
status.error.detail: The message below comes straight from spoti.
error.generic: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
error.noDevice: No active device. Pick one below or start Spotify somewhere.
error.premium: Spotify only allows remote control with Premium.
error.rateLimited: Spotify asked to slow down. Try again in a few seconds.
error.network: Spotify is not reachable right now.
devices.empty: No device online. Open Spotify on any device, or press Enter to turn this computer into a speaker with spotifyd.
favorites.empty: No favorites yet. Press f on a playlist, or Enter here to edit the file.
favorites.noneInFile: The favorites file has no entries. Press Enter to edit it.
search.typing: Type to filter, Enter to play
